name: Frontlines
primaryObjective: Score 1 VP for each controlled objective during every scoring Round.

tacticalObjective.name: Push Forward
tacticalObjective.effect: Gain 1 Tactical VP if you control at least one enemy-affiliated objective. For this Mission, an objective is enemy-affiliated to the opposing side as assigned during setup. Each side has two enemy-affiliated objectives at 2,000 Points and one Neutral objective.

specialRules: Objective affiliation is fixed during setup and recorded on the layout. Once assigned, it is independent of which side currently controls the objective or which force is physically nearer.
designNotes: Frontlines rewards offensive movement and forces players to commit Units beyond their safest positions. It is especially useful with diagonal, split, or staggered layouts.
